questions.q: The current age of Savan is four times the age of Akshan. 10 years from now, Savan’s age will be twice the age of Akshan. What is Savan’s current age?
questions.solution:
Let Current age of Akshan = X

Current age of Savan = 4X

Age of akshan after 10 years = X + 10

Age of Savan after 10 years = 4X + 10

As given in question,

4X + 10 = 2(X + 10)

4X + 10 = 2X + 20

X = 5 and 4X = 20

Hence age of savan is 20 years .

questions.q:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

40 + 10 ÷ 2 × 8 – 17 = 17
questions.solution:
Interchanging + and –

40 - 10 ÷ 2 + 8 + 17 = 40 - 5 × 8 + 17

40 - 40 + 17 = 17

Interchanging ÷ and ×

40 + 10 × 2 ÷ 8 + 17 = 40 + 25​ + 17 ne 17

Interchanging × and +

40 × 10 ÷ 2 + 8 - 17 = 40 × 5 + 8 - 17

200 + 8 - 17 ≠ 17

Interchanging ÷ and –

40 + 10 - 2 × 8 ÷ 17 = 40 + 10 - 172×8​

50 - 1716​ ne 17

Hence by interchanging + and – we get the correct equation.

questions.q: Which one of the following is the largest recognised constellation?

questions.q: In a class of 50 students, 60% are boys. The average of marks of the boys is 62, and that of the girls is 68. What is the average marks of the whole class?
questions.solution:
Total number of students in the class = 50

Number of boys in class = 50 × 60/100 = 30

Number of girls in class = 50 – 30 = 20

Average marks of girls = 68

Sum of marks of girls = 68 × 20 = 1360

Average marks of boys = 62

Sum of marks of boys = 62 × 30 = 1860

questions.q: Six cubes, each of edge 2 cm, are joined end to end. What is the total surface area of the resulting cuboid in cm²?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

6 individual cubes have a total of 6 × 6 = 36 faces.

Joining them end-to-end forms 5 joints between the cubes.

Each joint hides 2 faces, leaving 36 − (5 × 2) = 26 visible faces.

Area of each square face = a² = 2² = 4 cm².

Total surface area = 26 × 4 = 104 cm².

∴ The correct answer is 104 cm².

Alternate Method



Given:

Number of cubes = 6

Edge of each cube (a) = 2 cm

Formula Used:

Total Surface Area of a Cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

Calculations:

When 6 uniform cubes are joined end to end, a cuboid is formed where the length increases but breadth and height remain unchanged.

⇒ Length of the resulting cuboid (l) = 6 × 2 = 12 cm

⇒ Breadth of the resulting cuboid (b) = 2 cm

⇒ Height of the resulting cuboid (h) = 2 cm

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (l × b + b × h + h × l)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (12 × 2 + 2 × 2 + 2 × 12)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (24 + 4 + 24)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × 52 = 104 cm²

∴ The correct answer is 104 cm².

Additional Information

Total Surface Area of a Cube

The total surface area of a single cube of edge length 'a' is given by 6a², as it is composed of 6 identical square faces.

Joining 'n' Cubes

When 'n' cubes of side 'a' are joined end-to-end, the resulting shape is a cuboid with length 'n × a', while the breadth and height remain 'a'.

Lateral Surface Area

The lateral (or curved) surface area of a cuboid excludes the top and bottom faces. It is given by the formula LSA = 2h(l + b).

questions.q: What is the value of x so that the seven digit number 55350x2 is divisible by 72?
questions.solution:
Divisibility law of 8 ⇒ A number divisible by 8 if its last three digit is divisible by 8.

Divisibility law of 9 ⇒ A number divisible by 9 if sum of its digit is divisible by 9.

⇒ 55350x2 divisible by 8 if x = 3 or 7

If we put x = 3, then number become 5535032 which not divisible by 9

If we put x = 7, then number become 5535072 which divisible by 9, so we can say x = 7.

questions.solution:

questions.q:
In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.

Cows are amongst the gentlest of animals; none shows more passionate tenderness towards their young ones.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "none shows more".

Key Points

• In the original sentence, "Cows are amongst the gentlest of animals; none shows more passionate tenderness towards their young ones," the error lies within how the subject and verb in the second part ("none shows more passionate tenderness towards their young ones") are paired.

• Let's break it down for clarity:

• The subject in the first part of the sentence is "Cows," which is plural.

• The phrase "none shows more passionate tenderness towards their young ones" refers back to "Cows."

• The pronoun "none" can be singular or plural depending on the noun it refers to.

• Since it refers to "Cows" (plural), "none" functions as a plural pronoun in this context.

• The verb "shows" is singular, which does not match the plural context indicated by the pronoun "none."

• Therefore, to correct the grammatical error, the singular verb "shows" should be changed to the plural form "show" to match the plural subject.

• So the correct sentence is: "Cows are amongst the gentlest of animals; none show more passionate tenderness towards their young ones."

Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 3".
